name: com.longleap.xsollaid
description: Xsolla ID sign-in: OAuth2/OIDC authorization code + PKCE. Contracts and orchestration only; the browser popup and HTTP transport live in the XSOLLA_ID-gated companion assembly. Ships a drop-in account widget (LongLeap.XsollaId.UI) with its prefab under UI/, and a startup account flow (LongLeap.XsollaId.Accounts): Xsolla ID or guest before the save service starts, with guest progress merged into the account by per-key rules.
